Fine subtle film grain, restrained haze, practical cinematic light, readable silhouettes. Input images 1 and 2: player identity references (front and back); image 3: Entity identity reference. One player, head and shoulders, facing us, filling the square: yellow hood, black twin-lens gas mask, one black mitten finger held upright in front of the filter in a shh gesture. In EACH round lens, small and sharp, the reflection of the Entity: a black hunched shape with TWO amber eyes in each reflection. Dark mustard background, warm rim light on the hood. No other characters outside the reflections.
images.remaining_issue: The background includes faint office lighting rather than a completely plain mustard field, and the tiny reflected eyes may lose definition at 64 pixels.
